entities.summary: Rikard Bergh is a former professional tennis player from Sweden. He enjoyed most of his tennis success while playing doubles. During his career, he won six doubles titles and finished as a runner-up five times. He achieved a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 37 in 1992. Rikard Bergh was a athletes & competitors from Örebro (b. 1966-06-14, Örebro). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
